scope: The adapted C Block factory wing that houses the Rezan Has Museum at the Cibali tram-side approach in Istanbul. The model represents the street-visible historic host building and its museum entrance.
era: Standing adaptation of the Cibali Tobacco Factory as documented by Kadir Has University and the Rezan Has Museum.
geographicSelection: The named native POI 5081442512 is about 189 m from the mapped building anchor. Its identity was reconciled against the official entrance opposite the Cibali station, campus handbook’s C Block assignment and Qualla’s published coordinate inside the traced native wing. Way 525964000 is unnamed. The exact door is an estimate.

writtenSources.use: The museum establishes the tram-facing public entrance at the current Cibali campus.
The university’s current written building directory lists the Rezan Has Museum in C Block.
The host describes the preserved arched-window and red-brick factory elevations and the reuse of the lower level as a museum.
The museum identifies the former Vallaury factory and its continued exterior role in the restored campus.
The primary site survey identifies the museum and Faculty of Fine Arts together in Block C and distinguishes the masonry and steel additions. Text in Tables 53–54 only.
